title: Account priority scoring and scope heuristic for Sales/CS feature intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable scoring and scope-heuristic that Sales and Customer Success can use during first-pass intake of enterprise feature requests (non-bug). Goal: reduce discovery time from >1 week to <72 hours for clear requests, provide consistent signals to PM/Eng for prioritization, and ensure compliance/security flags surface early.
context: We receive ~30 enterprise feature asks/month across Sales and CS. Current intake is ad-hoc: PMs spend 60-90 minutes per ask to synthesize ask, gather stakeholders, and estimate. This creates backlog noise and inconsistent prioritization. The proposed heuristic is focused on fast, consistent triage so that high-value and low-effort items move quickly while complex asks are routed to a structured discovery flow.
scoring_rubric: Impact (0-5): revenue signal, number of accounts affected, upsell/renewal influence
Effort (0-5): estimated engineering baseline including infra and integration complexity
Strategic Fit (0-3): alignment with product pillars (serving reliability, enterprise controls, cost optimization)
Compliance Risk (0-3): data residency, PII, HIPAA/GDPR implications (automatically escalate if >1)
Time-to-value (0-3): can we deliver an MVP within 6 weeks?
Confidence (0-2): how well-defined is the ask; higher score if sales provides acceptance criteria / screenshot / workflow
decision_matrix: Fast-track: Impact>=4 AND Effort<=2 AND Time-to-value>=2 => assign to Quick Win pipeline (target SLA: 72h triage, 2-week delivery by PM+Eng small scope)
Discovery: Impact>=3 AND (Effort>=3 OR Compliance Risk>=2) => open Discovery ticket (2 sprint investigation with Eng/Infra/Legal reviews)
Backlog: Impact<=2 AND Effort>=3 => log into account backlog and communicate timeline to CS (low immediate investment)
Reject / Redirect: Compliance Risk>=3 OR Security red flags => escalate to Security & Legal for mandatory review before any scoped work
initial_scope_template: Who: list of accounts and number of seats/users impacted
Why: business outcome requested (e.g., lower latency for checkout, dedicated VPC for sensitive data)
How often: frequency/volume and example request payload size (if applicable)
Acceptance criteria: 3 clear conditions that indicate success
Integration points: SDK/API changes, Auth/NAT, CORS, KMS details
Privacy note: does this touch PII or regulated data? If yes, attach data flow diagram
Suggested rollout: pilot with X account(s), metrics to monitor (latency, error rate, cost delta)
communication_templates: 72h acknowledgement: 'Thanks — we reviewed this with PM. Based on initial scoring, this request is a candidate for [Fast-track|Discovery|Backlog]. We will follow up by DATE with next steps.'
Discovery kickoff: 'Kickoff scheduled with Eng, Infra, Legal on DATE. Expected discovery duration: 2 sprints.'
Rejected due to compliance: 'We cannot proceed without Security/Legal signoff. Please provide additional data flows and customer contract language.'
acceptance_criteria: CS or AE can complete the intake form in <15 minutes using the provided template
Triage score computed and visible on intake card in Linear within 24 hours
At least 3 pilot request examples are processed in the first 30 days and time-to-first-decision <72h for 80% of them
